question: What division of eight groups of eight is sought to be known fully?
premises: A division consisting of eight groups of eight is mentioned
Complete knowledge of this division is desired
The knowing is described as endless or exhaustive
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and exhaustively the division of the eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight.
